description: This file defines the WorkWeekService class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin's Service namespace. It provides a getWorkWeekDao method that initializes and returns an instance of WorkWeekDao, encapsulating data access related to work weeks.

classes.name: WorkWeekService
classes.description: Service class providing access to work week data through the DAO pattern. It manages an instance of WorkWeekDao that can be retrieved via getWorkWeekDao() method, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getWorkWeekDao
methods.description: Returns the WorkWeekDao instance used by this service, creating a new one if it doesn't already exist.
